name: pool
title: Pool
owns: Pool storage and migrations; admission records; Imperatives; accepted specifications; original rules and their projections, including temporary rules with an expiry or lift condition; generated knowledge projections. It is the one store that word persists decisions in.

commands.name: hive-pool
commands.purpose: Durable work items: identity, scope, dependencies, delivery path, dispatch class, holds and dates.

commands.name: hive-admit
commands.purpose: Immutable admission requests and receipts bound to an Imperative revision.

commands.name: hive-imperative
commands.purpose: The canonical Imperative: text, revision and digest, and what was delivered for each generation.

commands.name: hive-spec
commands.purpose: Specification revisions, acceptance receipts, requirement and evidence links, closure receipts.

commands.name: hive-rule
commands.purpose: Verbatim rulings, amendments, scope, effective and expiry times, supersession and the resolved-rule digest.

commands.name: hive-memory
commands.purpose: Generated knowledge projections, the maintenance queue and per-consumer acknowledgment.

test_scope: Record round trips, transitions, concurrent writes, migration and recovery, and rule expiry by the clock and lift by receipt.
